note: LIVE config. 'provider' selects an entry in runner/providers.json; a model can override it with its own 'provider' key. Every free Zen model ends in -free: OpenCode absorbs the cost, so the bench costs nothing but a key and a rate limit. reps is 3 here instead of 5 because the free roster is 10 models: 10 * 5 tasks * 2 variants * 3 reps = 300 calls per full sweep.

variants.vanilla: You are an expert Python developer. Solve the task exactly as specified.
variants.minimal: You write the least Python that fully satisfies the spec. Standard library only. No classes, no abstractions, no comments, no error handling beyond what the spec requires, no extra features. A few clear lines beat a clever framework. Output only the code.
